title.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型权重已发布
title.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights are out

current_state.zh:
Moonshot AI 已公开 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型权重，模型仓库已在 Hugging Face 上线，可供下载和自行部署。该发布在 Hacker News 上获得 426 分和 125 条评论，有用户指出第三方推理服务商在数小时内就开始上架该模型。

评论者表示第三方服务商已经开始提供该模型，其中一位称 Together 在相同价格下的吞吐量约为 Moonshot AI 自家端点的两倍，而 Modal 又是其两倍左右，显示托管访问渠道正在发布方之外迅速铺开。

讨论集中在模型是否针对基准测试做了优化：一位评论者认为它并未明显超越 DeepSeekV4.1-Flash，且在另一家实验室的内部基准上得分一般；另一位则表示自己的测试未发现“刷榜”迹象，称其是一款略逊于前沿但表现出色的开放模型。有用户估计本地运行大约需要 8 张 B300 的节点。
current_state.en:
Moonshot AI has published the open weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro, with the model repository live on Hugging Face for download and self-hosting. The release drew 426 points and 125 comments on Hacker News, where users noted that third-party inference providers began listing the model within hours.

Commenters reported that third-party providers are already serving the model, with one saying Together offers roughly double the throughput of Moonshot AI's own endpoint at the same price and Modal roughly double that again — a sign that hosted access is opening up beyond the releasing lab.

Discussion centered on whether the model is tuned to maximize benchmarks: one commenter argued it does not clearly outpace DeepSeekV4.1-Flash and scores modestly on another lab's internal benchmarks, while another said their own testing did not show benchmark-gaming and called it a strong open model slightly off the frontier. One user estimated running it locally would require something like an 8x B300 node.

updates.background_zh: 开放权重指已训练模型公开释放的学习参数，任何人都可以下载并在本地运行，但这并不必然意味着训练数据或授权条款同样开放。Moonshot AI 是 Kimi 系列模型的开发方；检索结果显示，Kimi K3.1 Pro 及一个 Highspeed 版本已在 Kimi.ai、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 和公司 API 上线。
updates.background_en: Open weights are the publicly released learned parameters of a trained model, allowing anyone to download and run it locally, though not necessarily with open training data or licence terms. Moonshot AI is the developer of the Kimi model family; search listings state that Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed variant are live on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and the company's API.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 整体情绪偏正面，但对基准成绩的可信度存在分歧：多位评论者称该模型“刷榜”（benchmaxxed），也有人反驳说自己的测试没有发现这种情况。另一些人关注实际问题，如自行部署所需的硬件，以及更便宜、更快的第三方推理服务迅速出现。
updates.community_discussion_en: Sentiment was broadly positive but split on benchmark credibility: several commenters called the model "benchmaxxed," while another pushed back that their testing did not show this. Others focused on practicalities — the hardware needed to self-host, and the rapid arrival of cheaper or faster third-party inference.
updates.market_impact_zh: 一款可广泛下载的开放权重模型，加上多个相互竞争的托管端点，主要通过推理定价影响加密 AI 基础设施：去中心化算力与推理市场面对的是同一批服务需求，讨论中提到的这些新进入者对每 token 成本构成压力。其传导路径在于模型服务的商品化，而非代币供应或托管渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: A widely downloadable open-weight model with multiple competing hosted endpoints affects crypto AI infrastructure mainly through inference pricing: decentralized compute and inference marketplaces compete on the same serving demand, and the entrants cited in the thread put pressure on per-token costs. The effect runs through commoditized model serving rather than through any token supply or custody channel.
